description: Finds the dates where the property's clicks (or impressions) moved to a new sustained level — a step up or down that holds for several weeks, as after a Google update, a migration or a content launch — using a robust CUSUM on the weekly (default) or daily series. Each point has date, direction, before/after averages (4 observations each), change, changePct and how many following observations stayed on the new level. Isolated spikes are not change points (see detect_anomalies). Default period 52 weeks. Use to date a lasting drop or gain and then correlate with get_annotations. / Degraus sustentados na série (semanal ou diária), com antes × depois.

brand.description: all (default); branded = only queries containing one of the property's branded_terms; non-branded = the rest. Needs branded terms set on the property in the Organiq panel, otherwise invalid_argument with the panel URL. / Marca × sem marca.

country.description: Country as ISO-3166-1 alpha-3, as in Search Console: bra, usa, prt, arg.

days.description: Window length in days (default 28). Ignored when startDate and endDate are both given. / Janela em dias.

endDate.description: End yyyy-mm-dd. Default: last synced date of the property (Search Console lags ~3 days; never "today"). Every response states the period used. / Fim; padrão = última data sincronizada.

granularity.description: week (default; incomplete edge weeks dropped) or day.

limit.description: Most recent change points to return (default 10).

pageContains.description: Only pages whose URL contains this text (case-insensitive), e.g. "/blog/".

query.description: Only queries containing this text, or a regex as /…/ (e.g. "/^how to/"; no flag = case-insensitive).

sensitivity.description: low = only large steps, medium (default), high = smaller steps.

site.description: Property: displayName ("example.com"), Search Console siteUrl ("sc-domain:example.com", "https://www.example.com/") or numeric id. A unique substring among visible properties also works ("exam"). list_sites shows the options. The value "demo" selects a demonstration site with fictional data: it works without signing in and is read-only. / Propriedade por nome, siteUrl ou id; "demo" é um site de demonstração com dados fictícios, sem login e só leitura.

name: detect_change_points
title: Sustained level shifts (change points)
